display_long_description:
In this VR simulation, experience the precision of an outside-in meniscus repair, the ideal technique for anterior horn tears! Enter a virtual operating room, where high-resolution imaging guides you through diagnosing and repairing a vertical longitudinal tear in the anterior horn of the medial meniscus. Using haptic-enabled tools, you’ll insert sutures from outside the joint to the inside, ensuring a secure, controlled repair with minimal tissue disruption.
Feel the realistic textures and resistance as you navigate the delicate knee anatomy, placing each stitch with expert precision. With immersive 3D visuals and interactive feedback, you’ll gain hands-on experience in perfecting this technique. Step into the virtual operating room and refine your surgical skills today!
